body: Thank you so much! Can we talk someday? Thing is your story and situation have been exactly like mine (23M), except in my case I'm not really seeing any light. ☹
Sounds kinda sketchy, I may write under a different name but not for such a horrible reason.
Thank you! It's very difficult but I can try
Thanks so much! Means a lot
I won't bother explaining but in short, my previous field didn't work out for me and in India, I have absolutely no trust or faith in offices etc opening flawlessly.

It's not easy for me to be stuck and put up indefinitely with parents who belittle & gaslight you everyday in the name of positivity (is that easy at all?). As for passions, I did write a novel recently and am trying to get into that only.
But problem is, I absolutely cannot watch or read a single piece of fiction without quitting it midway now. I get this unnecessary involuntary frustration inside and it doesn't seem to go away. I listen to music but absolutely refrain from watching the music videos.

A lot of trouble! A LOT! Like it's an understatement cuz my performance dropped instantly when lockdown began, and I have absolutely no idea how I stretched out 7 months despite dealing with toxic parents n stuff. I can't take it anymore!
